rationale: The bounded product-semantics change spans three canonical owners and requires migrating multiple consumers. It is ineligible for verified_change because ownership is not singular and propagation is not deterministic. It is also ineligible for compact_delivery because the evidence does not show a completed Brownfield Review or stored quick_task context. With no architecture, runtime, policy, persistence, security, external API, CLI, release, or cross-host impact supplied, structured_slice is the proportional candidate rather than structured_delivery.
decision_grounds: Synthetic durable UR is approved for measurement.
Three canonical owners and three source paths require coordinated consumer migration.
Four derived paths exist, but deterministic propagation is false.
verified_change requires exactly one canonical owner and deterministic propagation when derived paths exist; both checks
Compact_delivery prerequisites are not evidenced: completed Brownfield analysis and stored quick_task context are absent
No supplied impacts indicate architecture, runtime, policy, persistence, security, external API, CLI contract, release,
Classification is non-authorizing; any broader impact requires fail-closed escalation.
